bug_risk.instructions: How likely is this diff to introduce a bug a reviewer would have to catch?
criteria: Cosmetic or mechanical change, no behaviour change
Behaviour change that is straightforward and self-checking
Behaviour change with edge cases or state that a reviewer must trace
Likely wrong: inverted condition, off-by-one, lost error handling, or a silent fallback

logic_in_component.instructions: Does the diff add business logic to a UI component or page: branching on domain values, arithmetic, building an API request, deriving a field from list position?

criteria.true: Yes, such logic is added or grown inside a component or page file
criteria.false: No, the logic lives in a service, store or lib, or nothing of the kind is added

missing_test.instructions: Does the diff change a pure function or service behaviour without a matching spec change in the same diff (see specChangedInSameDiff)?

criteria.true: A service, store or lib behaviour changed and no spec was touched
criteria.false: A spec was touched, or the change carries no testable behaviour

published_snapshot.instructions: Does the diff write to, mutate or delete a published schedule snapshot instead of the draft?

criteria.true: A published snapshot is modified or removed
criteria.false: Only the draft is written, or scheduling is not touched
